title: Astonischika
description:
Astonischika is a turn-based pixel role-playing game with a roguelite loop. Build a party from bold classes, climb a branching map and fight turn by turn against monsters, elites and bosses.

Every run is different: you choose your path across battles, rest sites, treasure, merchants and minigames. When your party falls, the city remains your permanent home — your heroes, their gold and their gear grow from run to run.

- Build your party from a range of classes — warrior, mage, cleric, rogue, archer and more
- Turn-based battles with skills, spells, elements and status effects
- Branching map: battle, elite, boss, rest, treasure and merchant
- Level-ups, attribute points, equipment and learnable spells
- Minigames: shell game, dice, memory, coin flip and more
- A permanent city hub — your progress stays after every run

This is the developer's Linux desktop version (an SDL2 build). The forum post reports on the iOS app's VoiceOver support; the game is also on iOS and Android, and on Windows through the Microsoft Store.
